name: reference_pbe_sssp
description: Fitted PBE/SSSP bulk diamond reference from 5-point hydrostatic QE series.

elastic_tensor.citation: Diamond cubic stiffness constants as used by Udvarhelyi, Shkolnikov, Gali, Burkard & Palyi, Phys. Rev. B 98, 075201 (2018), attributed therein to E. Kaxiras, Atomic and Electronic Structure of Solids (Cambridge University Press, 2003).
elastic_tensor.notes: The project's hydrostatic five-point bulk fit (bulk_reference.bulk_modulus_gpa) determines only B = (C11 + 2*C12)/3; it cannot independently determine C11, C12, and C44. These three values are literature-sourced pending a future DFT elastic-tensor campaign (independent strain modes; see PLAN_nv_strain_campaign.md). Do not treat them as project-derived DFT data.

notes: Use this fitted lattice constant as the default bulk PBE/SSSP reference for future slab and strain calculations.
Do not commit UPF pseudopotential files.
For slab surface-energy subtraction, use strain-matched bulk references rather than only the unstrained reference.
elastic_tensor.C11/C12/C44 are literature-sourced, not fitted from this project's DFT; see elastic_tensor.notes.
